disassembly_check: one packed-double FMA, one explicit vmovapd load, one FMA memory-source load, and one vmovapd store found in triad_pass; 2 loads and 1 store per 8 FP64 elements

binding.lock: flock -x /tmp/ozamx-perf.lock held for build, disassembly inspection, and complete run

protocol.batch_passes: power-of-two calibrated per thread-count/footprint, then fixed across warmup and five timed repetitions
protocol.timing: each OpenMP worker times the synchronized batch; CSV records maximum worker elapsed time
protocol.checksum: complete output-array sum after each timed batch, outside the timed OpenMP region
protocol.triad: a[i] = b[i] + 0.5*c[i], FP64; 2 logical ops and 24 logical bytes per element
protocol.bandwidth_semantics: logical traffic rate; hardware cache misses and physical DRAM traffic are not measured

footprint_hypotheses.label: LLC_candidate
footprint_hypotheses.caveat: candidate footprint only; not a guarantee of LLC residency

allocation: three independent 64-byte-aligned allocations per worker; each worker first-touches its own arrays via an OpenMP static, one-worker-per-partition schedule
analysis: L1/L2/LLC labels are footprint hypotheses, not measured cache-bandwidth classes. Rates are logical bytes/s and logical GFLOP/s, not hardware-counter traffic.
